title: 第10章 打拳代号屠夫第11章 傻X弄死我
content_zh:
“借钱。”
王生正气凛然道。
“我很快就会还你，不出意外周一开学就能还上。”
“这样呀，”刘盈婉应声道，“你想要借多少？”
“呃......给个几千块就够了吧，我练武需要买点东西，资金暂时周转不开。”
尽管他说得轻描淡写，但谁都知道王生家庭贫困，一个月的家庭收入也才不过几千块。
刘盈婉倒是没纠结这些问题，她微微歪头，眼皮眨巴了几下，盯着这个比自己高半头的小男生：
“呐，王生，我先问你个问题。”
“好，你问。”
刘盈婉声音悦耳：
“你也看到我爸对你的态度了，对吧？”
“嗯，他不喜欢我，能理解。”
王生点头回道。
“那你应该也知道，我现在，嗯......不是嫌弃你的意思，我是说，我家境情况和我的成绩你也了解了，为什么你还会不厌其烦地坚持来找我呢？”
王生不解：“你是在说我厚脸皮？”
“不对，才不是！”
刘盈婉用力甩头，那柔顺的长发如德芙般丝滑。
她努力想了下，似乎是在琢磨措辞，半晌才轻声道：
“故事里的小男生不都这样么？因为女孩优秀，家庭条件优越，然后觉得自卑配不上什么的，会主动冷淡关系......”
王生点头：“我懂，你是在说我不识时务。”

“不、不对！”
刘盈婉气得脸都红了。
“哈哈，开个玩笑而已。讲正经的，那些东西我才不会在乎，我人穷志不穷，没什么好自卑的......所以你能借我几千块吗？”
刘盈婉嘟嘴道：
“你还跟我玩，那你就不怕我爸吗？他可是很凶的。”
“不怕，又不是我爸。”
“但他可能会做一些过激的事情，如果被他发现我们还在一起玩的话......”
“哈哈！那有什么？你爸最好找人弄死我。”
王生大笑道。
这样免得他还要自己费功夫找死。
“胡说什么呢！他再怎么样也不可能杀你一个学生。”
刘盈婉气鼓鼓地嘟了下嘴，可爱极了。
似乎是弄清了心中的疑惑，刘盈婉看起来心情也好了些。
“你在这等着，我回家给你拿钱，很快的。”
content_en:
"Borrow money."
Wang Sheng said righteously and solemnly.
"I will pay you back soon. If nothing happens, you can pay it back when school starts on Monday."
"That's it," Liu Yingwan responded, "How much do you want to borrow?"
"Uh... a few thousand yuan is enough. I need to buy some things for my martial arts practice, and the funds are temporarily limited."
Although he spoke in an understatement, everyone knew that Wang Sheng's family was poor, and his family income was only a few thousand yuan a month.
Liu Yingwan did not dwell on these issues. She tilted her head slightly, blinked her eyelids a few times, and stared at the little boy who was half a head taller than herself:
"Now, Mr. Wang, let me ask you a question first."
"Okay, you ask."
Liu Yingwan’s voice is pleasant:
"You've also seen my dad's attitude towards you, right?"
"Well, I understand that he doesn't like me."
Wang Sheng nodded and replied.
"Then you should also know that now, um... I don't mean to dislike you. I mean, you also understand my family situation and my grades. Why do you still insist on coming to me after all the trouble?"
Wang Sheng was puzzled: "Are you calling me shameless?"
"No, it's not!"
Liu Yingwan shook her head vigorously, and her long and smooth hair was as smooth as Dove.
She thought hard for a moment, as if she was pondering the words, and then softly said after a while:
"Aren't all the little boys in the story like this? Because the girl is excellent and the family conditions are good, but they feel inferior and unworthy, they will take the initiative to cold-blooded relationships..."
Wang Sheng nodded: "I understand, you are saying that I am ignorant of current affairs."
"No, that's not right!"
Liu Yingwan was so angry that her face turned red.
"Haha, it's just a joke. To be serious, I don't care about those things. I am poor but ambitious, and I have nothing to feel inferior to... So can you lend me a few thousand yuan?"
Liu Yingwan pouted and said:
"You are still playing with me, so aren't you afraid of my dad? He is very fierce."
"Don't be afraid, he's not my dad."
"But he might do something extreme if he finds out that we are still playing together..."
"Haha! What's the point? Your dad had better find someone to kill me."
Wang Sheng laughed.
This would save him from having to go to great lengths to find his own death.
"What nonsense are you talking about! No matter what, he will never kill one of your students."
Liu Yingwan pouted angrily, she was so cute.
It seemed that she had clarified the doubts in her heart, and Liu Yingwan seemed to be in a better mood.
"You wait here, I'll get you money when I get home, soon."
